cantiere-01.text: Lucky digging: an old safe turns up under the foundations. Collect 120.

cantiere-02.text: The cement mixer blocks the crossroads at rush hour. Traffic fine: pay 80.

cantiere-03.text: Town grant for the solar panels on the new roof. Collect 90.

cantiere-04.text: Sudden rain on the fresh concrete: the driveway must be redone. Pay 70.

cantiere-05.text: Site opening with sandwiches and drinks for everyone. Pay 20 to every player.

cantiere-06.text: The neighbours chip in to thank you for the new pavement. Every player gives you 20.

cantiere-07.text: Special scaffolding inspection. Pay 20 for each house and 70 for each tower.

cantiere-08.text: The brick supplier gives you a bulk discount. Collect 35.

cantiere-09.text: Building site open without the proper sign: the Wardens take you to the Barracks.

cantiere-10.text: Back to the warehouse to fetch the bags of lime: move back 2 spaces.

cantiere-11.text: The work finishes ahead of schedule: how do you celebrate with the crew?
options: Hurry to {space} to sign a new contract

cantiere-12.text: A water pipe is leaking right under the scaffolding.
options: Fix it house by house: pay 25 for each house and 80 for each tower
